newsitem.title: INDIA: India tests short-range rocket missile -agency.
newsitem.headline: India tests short-range rocket missile -agency.

text.p: India on Tuesday successfully test-fired a short-range rocket missile forming part of an integrated missile programme, the United News of India (UNI) said.
It said the surface-to-surface Pinaka missile was fired from a testing site at Chandipur, a coastal town on the Bay of Bengal in the eastern state of Orissa.
India is carrying out an integrated missile development programme that includes making of surface-to-surface, surface-to-air and anti-tank missiles of varying ranges.
Trials of Pinaka, a mobile weapon system, would continue on Wednesday, UNI said.
